methodology.playerStats: Exact public SVHL player IDs; current GP/G/A/points, eligible archive stats from Winter 2011/12 onward
methodology.model: Empirical Bayes additive G/A rates with 4–14 source-prior pseudo-GP and current attendance shrinkage; new IDs without archival priors use qualified public league mean
methodology.historicalDivisionExperience: Retained as contextual evidence, unapproved official A–D tier
methodology.playerConfidence: Reported LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH based on qualified current and prior GP
methodology.goalsAssistsPoints: Full-season indicative counts including published current values, not guaranteed performance or official source updates
methodology.scoringOutput: Show current record, roster-aware future goal environment and projected G/A/P with uncertainty
methodology.rosterScenario: Bounded +/-6% projected GF scenario signal, limited to +/-15 Elo; research-only, not an approved relative division tier
methodology.crossNight: 70 exact public cross-night player IDs measured; numerical tier transfer weight zero pending division-level approvals and prospective validation
methodology.goalieAndSignedAttendance: Goalie statistics and signed game-sheet identities not verified at uniform quality, therefore no invented goalie ability/attendance
methodology.uncertainty: 80% descriptive Poisson-style bands are NOT independently calibrated predictive intervals
methodology.divisionGroupSize: Retain V23 validated group sizes and connected program boundaries; experimentally reorder teams by bounded roster scenario rating
methodology.externalValidation: Required before automatic league decisions, commercial performance claims or official schedules
